newsitem.title: USA: Premier Laser gets $2.3 mln in orders.
newsitem.headline: Premier Laser gets $2.3 mln in orders.

text.p: Premier Laser Systems Inc, which makes medical and dental lasers, said it received about $2.3 million in orders from practioners for its Centauri Erbium:YAG laser.
The Centauri Erbium:Yag laser was cleared for marketing last month by the Food & Drug Administration for the treatment of tooth decay, Premier said.
Shares of Premier Laser gained 1-1/64 to 11-17/64 in afternoon trading.

The company also said that it has processed to date more than 2500 inquiries from dentists throughout the United States and in a number of foreign countries, with an average of 150 calls each business day.

Inquiries range from product orders and requests for enrollment in company-sponsored training classes to requests for product literature and financing information. The Centauri is currently priced at $39,595, Premier said.
